definitions.explanation: Restricting or confining something to a certain scope, number, or condition. Often used to describe limited-edition products or exclusive access.

examples.japanese: ⟦{会員|かいいん}→会員：02535_kaiin⟧{限定|げんてい}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: It will be limited to members only.

examples.japanese: ⟦{数量|すうりょう}→数量：05473_suuryou⟧{限定|げんてい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{商品|しょうひん}→商品：01436_shouhin⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦すぐ→すぐ：00814_sugu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{売|う}り{切|き}れた→売り切れる：03012_urikireru⟧。
examples.english: The limited-quantity products sold out immediately.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{割引|わりびき}→割引：01526_waribiki⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{今月|こんげつ}→今月：00720_kongetsu⟧{限定|げんてい}な⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で、⟦{早|はや}め→早め：11176_hayame⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{申|もう}し{込|こ}んで→申し込む：02311_moushikomu⟧⟦ください→ください：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: This discount is limited to this month, so please sign up early.

notes:
{限定|げんてい} means to limit or restrict something to a specified scope or quantity.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {限定|げんてい}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (to limit, to restrict)
- {限定|げんてい}⟦{品|ひん}→品：03712_hin⟧ (limited-edition item)
- ⟦{期間|きかん}→期間：00229_kikan⟧{限定|げんてい} (limited time)
- ⟦{数量|すうりょう}→数量：05473_suuryou⟧{限定|げんてい} (limited quantity)
- ⟦{地域|ちいき}→地域：01461_chiiki⟧{限定|げんてい} (region-exclusive)
- ⟦{会員|かいいん}→会員：02535_kaiin⟧{限定|げんてい} (members only)

As a modifier, {限定|げんてい} is often placed directly before a noun: {限定|げんてい}⟦{販売|はんばい}→販売：03573_hanbai⟧ (limited sale).
